title: Assessing The Limits of Radial Expansion in Woody Tree Roots
content: Tree roots colonize cracks in rock and similarly confining spaces in built environments, contributing to natural weathering processes and urban infrastructure dysfunction. In this study, we assessed the limits of radial expansion in woody Quercus virginiana L. and Taxodium distichum (L.) Rich. roots grown in clamps under increasing tension. After two growing seasons, a maximum stress threshold for radial growth in mature structural roots was identified and was similar for both species.
